text.name: Taiwan Strait Crisis
text.rules: Record "strait crisis". LIO chooses: Send the carriers? If yes, LIO spends 2 points, then until the end of this turn, points spent by LIO count 1 less, never below 1; if no, SAE spends 3 points. Raise Escalation by 1.
text.history: China fired missiles into waters near Taiwan and held exercises from July 1995 to March 1996, ahead of Taiwan's first direct presidential election on 23 March 1996; the United States sent two aircraft-carrier groups to the area in March 1996.
